summary: Tested DHARA Pro UPI Payment Page (Phase 1) — standalone /pay-upi + /admin-upi-review pages and backend api/upi_billing_router.py. All 10 backend pytest cases pass, all frontend flows verified via Playwright. No critical bugs found. Test submissions and is_pro flag were cleaned up/reset after testing.

minor.issue: Problem statement says UPI_VPA/UPI_PAYEE_NAME are 'configured in backend/.env' — they are NOT present in the on-disk /app/backend/.env file. They are instead injected at process start via the platform's secrets tmpfs mechanism (/etc/supervisor/emergent-env-exec -> /dev/shm/emergent/app.env). Functionally this works fine (confirmed via live GET /api/billing/upi/config returning configured:true even after a backend restart), so this is NOT a bug, just a documentation/expectation mismatch worth noting for anyone grepping .env directly.

ui_bugs.issue: The floating 'Help' button (GlobalHelpButton, rendered globally in _layout.tsx) overlaps the bottom-right of the inline error message text on the pay-upi form on a 375px mobile viewport, partially obscuring the last line of the 'No DHARA account found...' error. Cosmetic only, text is still readable above the overlap.

action_items: Optional: give the floating Help button a lower z-index / move error text above it on pay-upi.tsx so it never visually overlaps form error messages (low priority, cosmetic).
No functional fixes required for Phase 1 — feature is working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: upi_billing_router.py is clean, well-documented, reuses existing check_admin_key/dependencies correctly, validates UTR length (6-40 chars), lowercases/trims email, excludes _id from Mongo responses, uses async/await throughout.

ConsentGuard allowlist change in _layout.tsx is minimal and correctly scoped to segments[0] === 'pay-upi' / 'admin-upi-review' only — verified via grep that no other frontend file references these two route names except the route files themselves and the auto-generated .expo/types/router.d.ts (expected, not a navigation link).
Admin endpoints correctly return 401 for both missing and wrong X-Admin-Key headers.
confirm endpoint is idempotent (checks sub['status'] != 'confirmed' before re-applying is_pro update) — good defensive coding.
reject endpoint correctly leaves is_pro untouched — verified directly in Mongo.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created and fully cleaned up: 4 test submissions (3 via pytest with UTR prefix PYTESTUTR*, 1 via Playwright UI with UTR PWTESTUTR000222) in upi_payment_submissions, all deleted after verification. is_pro/pro_provider/pro_since/pro_payment_ref on voicetest2026@example.com were temporarily set to true during the confirm-flow test and reset back to is_pro:false (fields unset) immediately after — verified final state in Mongo is {'is_pro': False} with no stray submissions remaining for that account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 UPI payment feature fully verified (backend config/qrcode/submit/admin-confirm/admin-reject + frontend pay-upi and admin-upi-review pages, consent-gate bypass confirmed, no in-app navigation links to either page, /upgrade screen regression smoke-checked as unaffected — it still goes through the normal consent gate as before, unrelated to this feature). Only a cosmetic Help-button overlap was found. Phase 2 (auto gateway confirmation) and Phase 3 (in-app billing) are known future work, not flagged as bugs per instructions.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs requiring RCA were found in this feature. The only noteworthy item (UPI_VPA/UPI_PAYEE_NAME not literally present in backend/.env on disk) is a platform secrets-injection behavior, not an application bug; confirmed functional via live API call before and after a backend restart.
